name: Common/Walk/Lu_Walk_Left
description: Relaxed left walk in place using eight contact, down, passing and up key drawings.
notes: User-approved eight researched keys and their original variable timing, promoted without repainting. Scale v6: one fixed whole-character transform per clip, matched to the standing-idle median opaque head silhouette area. It includes eyes/mouth, so blinking does not change the scale estimate. No frame-specific scaling, head/body cuts, or pose-height normalization. Grounded contacts remain y592; flight clearance is transformed about the shared root. Pose projection, breathing and original drawing proportions remain intact.
